description: This file appears to be a shell script for testing and managing git remote operations, including repository setup, remote addition, removal, renaming, configuration, fetching, updating, pruning, setting head references, and related verification tasks. It contains numerous test cases and utility functions centered around git remote management.

methods.name: setup_repository
methods.description: Initializes a new git repository with main and side branches and commits.

methods.name: tokens_match
methods.description: Compares two sets of tokens for consistency.

methods.name: check_remote_track
methods.description: Verifies if a remote track matches expected branches.

methods.name: check_tracking_branch
methods.description: Checks if tracking branches are as expected.

methods.name: get_url_test
methods.description: Tests various ways to retrieve remote URLs.
